496.synopsis:
This is a game that surpasses dimensions.
It is also a competition for the search of truth.
Unknown seals, a game of chance with ghosts and gods…
The digital struggle, the redemption of humans…
In the virtual world that links with reality—It consciously decided us. It consciously chose us. It consciously decided our consciousness.
And now, throw away your fear.
Throw away your selfish thoughts, questions, and resistance… Free your mind.
Welcome to: Thriller Paradise.

752.synopsis:
High school student Kanda Shun had always been incapable of imagining. Until one day, when he wished Princess Rosalie, resident heroine of the popular RPG game ‘Dragon Bless’ out into the real world! Havoc occurs as Princess Rosalie pries opened drawers, breaks vases and pots, and swings a life-sized, ruby encrusted sword around at the first sign of danger.
Furthermore, Rosalie declares, out of the blue, that Shun be her husband, and she would stop at nothing to bring him happiness. On top of that, Shun would have to deal with Nadeshiko, ruler and tyrant of his high school, as well as the over-affectionate and doting cousin, Mikoto!
How in the world is a guy supposed to handle all of that?!

1776.synopsis:
Hiroyaki Kuze, part of the Ground JSDF, was assigned to the fleet of JSDF ships being sent as reinforcements to a UN mission. The flagship of the fleet is the Aegis class Destroyer Ibuki. However on their way a girl with wings transported their fleet to another world. A fantasy world of Swords and Magic. Kuze’s platoon was sent out scouting to see where they were. His platoon found and landed in the capitol of the United Kingdom. Kuze’s platoon attempted to withdraw when there was an attack by the Filbolg Empire on the capitol. However when children were in danger they protected them. The Empire regards them as reinforcements for the Kingdom!
On land and sea the power of the JSDF in the arena of warfare explodes! The alternate world JSDF fantasy that was popular on the net has made it’s long awaited novel debut!
associated_names: ルーントルーパーズ 自衛隊漂流戦記

2288.synopsis:
Interview (YGZ – Father, ZZ – Mother, ZW – Son)
1. What is something you carry everywhere with you?
YGZ: A gun.
ZZ: I prefer being indoors, specifically inside a lab.
ZW: Anything that has access to the internet.
2. What is your favorite hobby?
YGZ: Shooting.
ZZ: Experimenting.
ZW: Hacking.
3. What is your worst fear?
YGZ: My wife’s cooking.
ZZ: My lab burning.
ZW: No access to the internet.
4. What is your spirit animal and why?
YGZ: A Bigfoot – has hands to hold a gun.
ZZ: An eagle – has good vision, useful for observing.
ZW: A Spider – can spin a web.
5. What is your biggest regret?
YGZ: Letting my wife escape after our first night.
ZZ: My son being a genius. I chose YGZ to be the father of my child because I thought he was a limbo.
ZW: Not reuniting my parents sooner.
associated_names: Tian Cai Bao Bei Qiao Lao Po

6640.synopsis:
In 2031 A.D. mysterious crystal bodies referred to as 『C.E.』 attacked. Humanity was gradually pushed down the road to ruin.
This is the story of a great hero who save the Earth from destruction with his shining holy sword――not.
In history during humanity’s grimmest hour, this is the story of the overshadowed hero, a lone spear user.
In often cases, this would be a story about a cheat protagonist and his harem; but, this story is from the point-of-view of a supporting character that shows the conspiracy behind such plots.
Basically, the theme is school battles.
associated_names: 英雄《しゅやく》になれない槍使い

8176.synopsis:
The first time they met……she was an eleven year old sweetie pie accompanying her father to the opening ceremony of a library. Her father introduced her to a twenty five year old handsome business acquaintance who was attending the same ceremony. She called him Uncle Wen.
The second time they met……she and her university room mates were posing and taking pictures of themselves by a Rolls Royce. She was eighteen then and was thoroughly embarrassed when she realised that he was inside the car looking out at them in amusement.
The third time they met…..it was another year and half later, and this time, she agreed to marry him in order to save her father’s company. She still insist on calling him Uncle Wen.
Wen Ze was already thirty four years old, chairman of a huge conglomerate and finds himself marrying twenty year old Luo Shang Er, a pretty university student.
Both are inexperience with affairs of the heart, physically and emotionally. What exactly propel Wen Ze to commit himself in this marriage? Seems like a true marriage of convenience. One was marrying out of filial duty and another was marrying because he is at an age where he should start a family. How will the marriage pen out for two persons who are almost total strangers? How long will it take before love eventually weave its way into their hearts?
When will she stop calling him Uncle Wen?
associated_names: My Silly Girl (Cherished Moments of After Marriage)

8688.synopsis: As an aristocrat, Melida Angel studied at an academy that developed mana users but she did not have any mana. Kufa Vampir was dispatched to be her tutor and at the same time he was ordered to assassinate the girl if she did not have any talent. “Do you want to try to entrust your life to me?” he asked, as not an assassin nor a tutor but as someone that was betting on his pride as an assassin tutor, to show the girl’s worth to the world.

12272.synopsis:
Pang Jing Dong hid himself among the cities, with the only intention to live a normal life.
Even so, his past clung hard onto him, together with all the conflicts he once had, dragged him into a swirl of chaos between various authorities.
A world with countless undiscovered secrets, and would he be able to have a breakthrough and go wherever he please?

14576.synopsis: Tian Man Continent is a world of martial arts. A young boy named “Su Yi” led countless yao (monsters or demons) and overrode countless families who had thousands of years of history. He rose abruptly in the world as the brightest star in the sky. He married beauties and walked towards the peak of of the world, and finally ascended onto the thrones of the ancient gods!

15344.synopsis:
This is the story of the youth Wen Leyang, born into the family with an expertise in the cultivation of the Art of Poison.
The enemy may not always be evil, and neither does someone evil necessarily be the enemy. However, one thing is certain. Wen Leyang is a frank and honest young man, a delightful hero who posseses a kind disposition towards any living creature.
Learn about his journey as he embarks on an adventure of cultivating into an immortal.

17392.synopsis:
In all my life, I’ve only made two mistakes that I regret. The first was filling out my entrance exam application wrong, and the second was offending Zhong Yuan. If I had to use an idiom to describe the impact of my mistake, it would be simply, ‘Life is no better than death’. And if I had to use an idiom to describe Zhong Yuan’s offenses to me, it would be simply, ‘Too many crimes to record’. And yet, for as evil and wicked as he was, he attracted girls the way that flowers attracted bees and butterflies.
It happened that one day, for some reason, I taunted Zhong Yuan, “The King of Hell sent you to torture some more people, didn’t he?” Without a change in expression, he replied, “In order to torture fewer people, I decided to just choose one person to torture for the rest of my life.” I asked him, “What do you mean?” He smiled at me and answered, “If you don’t go to hell, who will?”
associated_names: Ni Bu Ru Di Yu Shui Ru Di Yu

19440.synopsis:
Su Xin was a world-class hitman. One day, she died in a disaster and was bound to the Fate Trading System to change other people’s destiny and increase her own life span.
Brothel prostitute: I want to become the first beauty of the Four Countries!
Imprisoned Mermaid: I want to return to the deep sea and become queen!
Adorable little girl: My elder sister is not human, kill her!
Miss Republic of China: Don’t let older brother be extremely infatuated with third aunt!
Su Xin: Your circle is really messy…

20464.synopsis:
“My name is Yang Jian, when you are reading this, I am already dead.”
A mysterious sheepskin scroll, an eye that peers into darkness, this is the tale of a survivor

22256.synopsis:
The traitorous general Gu Mang was returning to his homeland. Everyone wanted to see him dead, and it was said that the one who hated him most was his former best friend—the cold and ascetic Young Master Mo. 
The rumours said: Young Master Mo prepared three hundred and sixty-five methods of torture to interrogate him with, just waiting to try them out on Gu Mang. They were so varied it was more than enough to toy with him for a year without repetition. 
Except these rumours were very quickly forbidden by Young Master Mo. The reason given was that they described him as a lunatic, and were severely inconsistent with reality.
So what was the truth?
The truth was even more unspeakable—
Mo Xi’s identity: the most abstinent commander of the empire.
His relationship with the traitor Gu Mang: they’d slept together before.
associated_names: สิ้นแสงอนธการ

23280.synopsis: This is a story about a young man who sought to fight against his destiny. With the help from billions of Dragon Energies trapped on the Rising Dragon Pillar in his body, he emerged from the dark and quenched himself with the blood of ancient dragons. He fought the heaven with the Buddhist Art for the people he loved and built the Eternity Kingdom with his own hands. This is a story about the rise of the Martial Emperor who will rule both earth and heaven.

23792.synopsis:
One day, a 28-year-old company employee suddenly dies. Being made to reincarnate to a certain planet by a mysterious young man, this is a tale of how he conveniently uses his overflowing abilities to go on a simple journey. Although he is the strongest protagonist, he does not realize his strength.
This is not a story where a cute girl comes out. There is no harem. There is not a single element of romance.
This is the life in another world of a young man who, along with his unique comrade, continued on a journey while collecting raw materials. And so~ometimes fights.
associated_names: 素材採取家の異世界旅行記

24304.synopsis:
This is a cruel fairy tale in the real world.
When Jiang Youyou, a girl who grew up in an orphanage, went to Shenzhen (City) alone to work, she didn’t expect the unimaginable humiliation and torture awaiting her.
She struggled at the darkest, most terrible corners of society until she met him.
However, it seemed fate was kidding her…

24560.synopsis:
Upon waking up, Ruan Xia had transmigrated into a webnovel that she had stayed up all night to finish reading. She had become the villain’s mother. 
In the novel, after the death of her first husband, the original owner of the body had hooked up with a Mr. Perfect at the fastest possible speed. Worried and discontent that her son from her first marriage would become a burden on her, she heartlessly abandoned her son.
Having once held the best quality script and informed of future events, Ruan Xia looked at her still alive first husband as well as her future villain son. She sighed. She wanted to apply for a different script!
associated_names: Xuyên Thành Nhân Vật Phản Diện Thân Mụ

30192.synopsis: In order to save her mother five years ago, Jiang Sese went to him and chose to never see her child again after giving birth to them. Five years later, an adorable child started pestering her for kisses, hugs, and asked to sleep together with her. Jiang Sese happily gave in to the child’s every request.
associated_names: 萌宝找上门：妈咪，请签收 全文阅读

32240.synopsis: Locke is a middling officer in the Kingdom of Faustian’s army.  He happens to be at the wrong place at the wrong time, or the right place at the right time, depending on your perspective, and happens to save the kingdom’s princess.  As fortune would have it, love prospers, but in a world of peasantry and nobility, a middling, peasant-born soldier has no right to love a princess.  Locke is nothing if not determined, however, and sets out to become someone worthy of loving the princess, someone her family can accept.  But that path is neither short, nor safe, as our hero will soon discover.

33776.synopsis:
One day, Li Yu transmigrated into a fish. Furthermore, this fish even had a master. This master was the sinister and terrifying mute tyrant from a novel. The system gave Li Yu a task. If he wanted to change back into a human, he had to obtain the tyrant’s heart. 
Li Yu full of tears: System, please wake up. I’m only a fish. He can’t even speak. How can we interact?
System: Stop jabbering. To take down the tyrant, you must attack his heart.
Li Yu: Can I ask, does the tyrant have a heart–
Li Yu did his best to blow bubbles at the tyrant, but ended up being captured by the tyrant and raised carefully in a huge, ginormous…… fish tank. The life of a fish was filled with all sorts of blessings.
Everyday, Mu Tianchi watched the little carp swim around happily, pondering when this fish would finally transform into a human.
The little carp didn’t know. It’s not that the tyrant had no heart, it’s just that he already gave it away to the little carp that accidentally saved his life.
associated_names: Can Ji Bao Jun De Zhang Xin Yu Chong [Chuan Shu]
Ngư Sủng Trong Lòng Bàn Tay Tàn Tật Bạo Quân
The Disabled Tyrant's Beloved Pet Fish
Tàn tật bạo quân lòng bàn tay cá sủng [ Xuyên thư ]
เมื่อผมกลายเป็นปลาตัวโปรดของอ๋องทรราช
残疾暴君的掌心鱼宠[穿书]

34800.synopsis:
When Yu Ci woke up, he was perched on top of a 20 meter high branch with an unknown bird standing on his head. With a dull tone, the bird said, “Look downwards, this is the land I have conquered for you.” Unfortunately, the gifted land was barren. Then the strange bird gave him two options:
1- Turn the wasteland into a farm
2- Friendship gift’s a pile of shit, so he’ll kick him down to become a pile of shit.
Yu Ci, trembling in fear, picked up the small hoe and started the story of forced farming. 
Since then, Yu Ci diligently tilled the land, until one day he stumbled upon a pearly white egg in the wasteland. A beautiful man hatched from the egg.
When the man was happy, it would be a peaceful, sunny day with soft, gentle breezes.
When the man was angry, there would be thunder rumbling and lightning flashes.
When the man pursed his lips and was being uncommunicative, there would be an overcast.
Yu Ci: ??
Qi Huai noticed the youth who hatched him was always smiling at him, gently and patiently coaxing him, buying him clothes and sweets. As long as he requested something, there would be nothing that can’t be done. Afterwards, Qi Huai found out the truth. This person was cajoling him into a humanoid weather controller to make the farm crops grow better.
Qi Huai: Scum. 
On this day, the sun was blazing hot and all the plants on the farm were drooping their heads. Yu Ci was extremely distressed at the sight, pulled on Qi Huai’s hand and asked, “Could you please cry for a moment? This place needs a good rain. The more tears, the better.”
The other party had a faint smile as he pressed against Yu Ci, “I can cry, but I can also make you cry. It won’t matter how loud you’re being.”
Yu Ci: …..
associated_names: 被迫种田后我震惊世界

35312.synopsis:
“Nice to meet you, I’m Yoon Hwayoung.”
The man, more beautiful than a woman, smiled like a flower. Gyuwon, his bodyguard, flushed up to his ears with his head bowed. Nearly two meters tall, lean muscles, bronze skin, tall nose, pronounced cupid’s bow, thick eyebrows, and narrow eyes… This shy man’s appearance was too hideous despite being a bodyguard. Born with an athletic physique and senses, he made a living as a mercenary, but stopped because had such a complex that he planned on getting plastic surgery. 
Compared to him, Hwayoung was beautiful. With an amazingly beautiful face, fantastic body, and a well-paid job, he was the third son of the Yoon Group, a nationwide gang syndicate. He was being stalked for his exquisite charm. The Yoon Group hires Gyuwon to protect their beloved, youngest family member and reluctantly welcomes him, but Hwayoung’s eyes immediately shone. To Hwayoung who wanted to raise a big, strong, pretty cat, Gyuwon was the ideal man he had been looking for.
One day, he followed Hwayoung into a gay, exclusive SM club, “DUNGEON,” while guarding him.
“Do you know what I’m best at? Recognizing masochists. Must be instinctual.”
Hwayoung looked at Gyuwon with a kind but cruel smile. Seeing at a glance that Gyuwon was an SMer with an inclination for being a gay sub, Hwayoung suggested that they be play partners… Gyuwon realized that the ideal type he’d always wanted was right in front of him, and felt that he would unconditionally obey Hwayoung. He weakly resisted, but when Hwayoung’s hand touched him, a groan escaped his throat.
“Your crying voice is really lovely, Gyuwon.”
Gyuwon’s back felt sweetly numb. The oncoming pain from was just a prelude to sweet pleasure.

36848.synopsis:
Right when Drako Yau, the chairman and game designer of a game company, is about to release the open beta of the game which he has been developing for years, things go awry. Another company suddenly launches a game which can be played using the brainwave technology, Real World. The map, background, game mechanics, and many more; everything is almost identical to the game he has designed.
Out of curiosity and bitterness, he enters the game, only to find that he cannot log out of it. He has to struggle in what seems to be a game, with his life on the line.

37104.synopsis:
When the apocalypse came, everyone struggled to survive. Yang Hao, a dorm caretaker, was forced out to find food. During the crisis, he found out that he could pick up attributes dropped by zombies to strengthen himself.
“You picked up the strength attribute, strength +1.”
“You picked up the agility attribute, agility +1.”
“You picked up the mutation attribute, blood awakening.”
“You picked up a red envelope, obtained three bottles of mineral water!”
“You picked up the silver treasure chest, obtained titanium pike!”
“Beauties, food, and the vast lands, they are all mine!” Yang Hao loudly shouted as he looked at the densely packed zombies.
From then on, corpses of mutants, evolved beasts, and ancient warriors piled up under his feet.

39920.synopsis: Through the efforts of its clansmen, a small family of cultivators slowly established itself into a clan of immortals. This is the record of how a single, small clan came to flourish in strength and numbers.
associated_names: Rise of the Green Lotus Family Sect

41456.synopsis:
Ten years in the last days, like drinking cold ice.
Dark plagues come, before ancient fans return to the last days, the king who sees through the heart of indifference will completely subvert the world!

42480.synopsis:
He was Madat, the most powerful and greatest high priest of Kandar, one of the five places in the continent.
Although he was a human closest to God, while at the same time, a representative of God, he couldn’t at least be freed from the curse strangling him since he was born.
Black hair, black eyes.
She was Seren, the one who resembled the mermaid in a legend orally passed down, said to be a symbol of misfortune in the world.
She, who was captured as a thank you gift that would be offered to Madat, whispered to him to kill all the villagers who had betrayed her.
“Then what will you give me? If you ask me for a favour for one reason or another, I expect that you would have something to offer to me. I don’t think you’re naive to the point you wouldn’t know that.”
“I will be able to offer an exhilarating time to Lord Madat.”
Seren was a smart and cunning woman, and at the same time, an unique woman,
And so, Madat chose her.
****
“I love you.”
The person whom Madat loves dies no matter what.
The beginning of the curse
Is ‘Awakening.’
associated_names: Siren: The Beginning of the Curse

43248.synopsis:
I was born weak and passed away at the age of 18 due to illness. Before I die, I made a wish to be born again.
It came true but was born blind. Little by little I came to know the gaps between the previous world and present one thanks to my fiancé. This is the story of the Duke’s only daughter.
associated_names: I was Reincarnated as a Blind Duke’s Daughter
Moumoku no Koushaku Reijou ni Tensei Shimashita
盲目の公爵令嬢に転生しました

46576.synopsis:
I transferred to a new school because of family reasons and was excited about my new school life.
But when I went to school, I found out that the seat next to me was occupied by my ex-girlfriend.
It would be fine if she was just an ex-girlfriend, but she is too jealous!
「Hey, why did you ignore me?」
「No, we broke up, right?」
「We didn’t break up, though?」
「Huh!?」
A youthful romantic comedy with a jealous ex-girlfriend!
associated_names: The Girl Sitting Next to Me at the New School I Transferred to Was My Ex-girlfriend – If Only She Could Get Rid of Her Jealousy, She’d Be the Perfect Girl!
俺の転校先の学校の隣の席は完璧美少女元カノだったー嫉妬さえ失くしてくれたら本当に完璧美少女なのにー

51184.synopsis:
I got bitten by a crazy dog, and now I can’t run away from this situation for the rest of my life.
The hero of the war was that crazy dog.
Priestess Dialin had to prepare him for his social debut by transforming this wild creature assigned to her into a proper young master.
However…
Let alone raising him as a respected young master, the real challenge was turning him into a person in the first place.
A being who embodies ‘crazy,’ ‘bad,’ and ‘bastard’ is not someone who can easily be spoken to.
“Calm down!”
“Stay still!”
Dialin did her best to care for Ceres, focusing solely on the promised promotions and benefits.
“Stay by my side.”
“Feed me.”
“I don’t like it if it’s not Dialin.”
But as a result,
The crazy dog she had finally transformed into a human—filled with childishness, stubbornness, and recklessness—began to develop an obsession.
associated_names: Turning the Mad Dog into a Gentle Lord

52208.synopsis:
A former Japanese woman who was reincarnated as the villainous daughter of a certain anime avoids her engagement to the first prince by becoming gorimacho.
After getting her freedom, she goes out into society again in search of a partner who will love her even if she is gori and macho.
associated_names: Akuyaku Reijou ni Tensei Shita kedo Gorimacho ni Natte Konyaku Kaihi Shimasu
悪役令嬢に転生したけどゴリマッチョになって婚約回避します

52976.synopsis:
Makabe Shizuru grew up in a single-parent household, and was left alone after his mother was killed in a traffic accident.
However, on the night after the funeral, a man claiming to be his father appeared and offered to take Shizuru in.
And so, when he visited the man’s house, he found Hasumi Shion, a popular female student at the same high school, waiting for him there with a cold gaze.
‘Well, I’m proof of her father’s betrayal. That reaction is expected…’
Nevertheless, they were still siblings and were going to live together under one roof.
On the other hand, Shizuru has long been pursued by a beautiful, refined lady, Takinami Ruika, a senior student at his school.
A cold half-sibling and a refined lady(?) 
Shizuru, who was supposed to lead a quiet school life as the only member of the library committee, but one day, his surroundings became rowdy and colorful.
associated_names: The Demure Girl’s Unshakable Romcom in the After-School Library
放課後の図書室でお淑やかな彼女の譲れないラブコメ

58096.synopsis:
Ryouta Umihara is often misunderstood as a “yankee” because of his sharp eyes and his attitude. And because he excelled both in academics and martial arts he was dubbed as the “Intellectual Yakuza.” 
In the spring of his first year in high school he helps a teacher when she is in trouble due to a complaints from a parent, that teacher is the swimming club advisor, named Meiru Kishikawa. She is the object of admiration from all the boys and sometimes they called her “Lady Knight Sensei” and since Ryota lives alone, all he eats are convenience store lunch boxes and junk foods. When Meiru-sensei found that out she tried to feed Ryota home-cooked meals every chance she gets while saying that it’s for his nutritional management.
A year after that encounter Ryouta is now in his 2nd year and all the students believe that the Intellectual Yakuza is under the observation of Kishikawa-sensei but the truth is that they have become so close to each other as Kishikawa-sensei is always feeding Ryota home-cooked meals.They seem to be closer than of a teacher and student but they are not aware of it. Is what they’re doing “feeding”, “guidance”, or is it–
associated_names: お姉さん先生は男子高生に餌づけしたい

59120.synopsis:
“To falsely accuse you at the graduation party, and not only that, banish you from the kingdom—!? …This me, who’s madly in love with you—!?”
After Pia’s memories of her previous life had resurfaced, she came to realize that not only did her world resemble that of a certain otome game but also that her fiancé was amongst the capture targets. Thus, the 10-years-old Pia kindly requested her fiancé, Rufus, to annul the engagement. However, upon hearing the full truth, Rufus became furious.
“Then, shall we make a bet? Let’s see whether or not I’ll dissolve our engagement in seven years as you predicted.”
“Hyiiii—!”
The story of Pia, whose timidity was at MAX due to the misfortune of her previous life and role in the otome game, and how the cunning Rufus kept her away from danger as her surroundings wholeheartedly doted on her. Zero seriousness, zero stress.
associated_names: Yowaki MAX Reijou nanoni, Ratsuwan Konyakusha-sama no Kake ni Notte Shimatta
弱気MAX令嬢なのに、辣腕婚約者様の賭けに乗ってしまった

60400.synopsis:
One day, while living as just another C-rank hunter, I obtained the world’s only S-rank production class skill.
[The opportunity for characteristic evolution has sprouted.] 
[Attribute Granting (C) → Enchant (S)
– Special power is imbued in your items.
– The power of blessings is strengthened by the master’s teachings. Items are permanently imbued with special power.] 
The golden road I dreamed of was short-lived.
Something’s strange about this job change.
[Enchant ‘Brilliant (A)’ failed.] 
[Failure penalty triggered! ‘Shadow Dagger (C)’ is destroyed.] 
Why is it so difficult to manifest the skill I finally obtained?!
“Hunter Yun Ga-ho never moves as I expect.”
“Yun Ga-ho, why did you leave me behind?”
“That’s right. The kind of interest you’re thinking of.”
Why are you all starting to obsess over me?
On top of that, what? I’m the only key to the unconquered floors?
Something must be terribly wrong.
Yun Ga-ho, the irreplaceable S-rank production class skill owner.
The battle of nerves between hunters trying to seize(?) Yun Ga-ho.
And the truth of the World Tower revealed.
Can Yun Ga-ho achieve the golden future she desires?
associated_names: I Transferred to the SSS-rank Crafting Field

61936.synopsis:
Han Ting said, “For me, love isn’t everything. I may not be able to provide self-sacrificing love for you, but the love that accompanies you in ordinary life may be possible.”
Ji Xing understands that the love they seek is different, and the outlines of the dreams in their hearts are also different.
But she wanted to climb from the slope to the top of the mountain, stand beside him, face hardships, troubles and pain with him, and witness the beauty of this city with him.
They were dazzling stars who admired each other in their hearts, just like the night view of the capital that he showed her for the first time–
Calm, stunning beauty, so beautiful it is intoxicating.
associated_names: เธอผู้เปล่งประกายกว่าแสงดาว

62960.synopsis:
I thought I fell asleep because I was tired, but I actually possessed someone!
The maid of Duke Stanton, “Claire Mcllroy!”
Also, because of a crazy turn of events,
I look like the princess and have to act as her stand-in all the way to the fallen country of Volmo and the Immortal Empire.
Because of this, I fell into a lot of trouble.
The man who said he would kill me three years ago was the ‘mu*derous’ Emperor of the Immortal Empire. He kills monsters in cruel ways.
“Don’t get my attention. If we meet again… I will kill you.”
But Eden, who doesn’t seem to remember the past, starts to show Claire a lot of love for no reason.
“I was worried for a long time when you passed out. I even thought about whether or not I should kiss you.”
“You can do anything you want, lady. I’ll just stay still.”
Why did you become so friendly when it doesn’t fit you, you mu*derous Emperor?
…You didn’t find out, did you?

63728.synopsis:
After transmigrating through ten years and silently registering his name at the Shanmen for ten years, the system finally issued Ye Changge his first task: to take in some disciples!
Disciple One: A very ordinary mortal who carries an axe every day, cutting down trees, carrying water, and usually eats ordinary food.
A few years later, Disciple One left the mountain and destroyed the sky and earth as well as shattered the heavens with a slash of his axe…
Disciple Two: born evil and with the appearance of a young emperor, he once traveled through the Central Region and suppressed the younger generation, with no one being of match for him…

“She’s sleeping with such a blissful look on her face again…”
—Before long, Watanuki-senpai starts spending all her time in Touya’s room.
A strong, dignified beauty gradually becoming soft and defenseless in front of me—
A heartwarming, reward-filled high school rom-com!
associated_names: Kyuudou Bu no Bijin na Senpai ga, Ore no Heya de Onaka Dashite Neteru

103664.synopsis:
When Xuezhu was little, she loved to stay with the older brother who lived across from her house. 
He wore a light blue school uniform, sitting under the shade of a tree downstairs in the neighborhood, reading a book. 
The sunlight filtered through the gaps in the leaves, casting a warm glow on his handsome face, and it also settled in her heart. 
Even though many years later he had grown into a man in a suit, that school uniform still held all the awe of her youth.
—
Years later, they met again, and Xuezhu went to visit her older brother’s house. 
She knew she couldn’t act the same way as when she was a child—running around recklessly, touching things she shouldn’t. She quietly sat on the sofa, drinking water, and didn’t even touch the snacks she loved since childhood.
She bought a table full of her favorite snacks from memory, but she didn’t touch any of them, lowering her eyebrows. Her neck was soft and white, her posture demure and restrained, her hand resting on her knee. The edge of the paper cup she was holding left a cherry-colored lip print.
The man subtly opened his eyes, his Adam’s apple shifting slightly. Facing the neighbor girl who had grown up before his eyes, the memories of their time together gradually became clearer, subtly pulling at his heart, making him feel uncertain for a moment.

104176.synopsis:
Lin Yun, 36 years old, lost his wife early on. A mid-level manager in a private company and a single father, he’s been feeling the weight of a midlife crisis lately.  
His career has hit a rough patch, his relationship with his 14-year-old daughter is locked in a cold war, and he suffers from chronic shoulder pain that makes every day miserable.  
And just recently, he discovered a shocking secret—his daughter is a magical girl.  
A young girl, standing against extraordinary monsters, a hero protecting the city from attacks. That’s how the public sees magical girls.  
But he knows the truth—being a magical girl is dangerous.  
Should he stop her? Or should he respect her choice and find another way to protect her?  
Staring at the long-forgotten Heart Blossom gathering dust in his wardrobe, Lin Yun—the former magical girl who retired 19 years ago—faces the third major crossroads of his life.
associated_names: 下班，然后变成魔法少女

106480.synopsis:
Tae Ihyun, known as ‘Thunder Emperor’ and humanity’s strongest Legendary Hunter, one day decides to leave everything behind to become a web novelist.
However, having lived his entire life as an overpowered character, Ihyun’s novels critically lack ‘reality.’ To solve this problem, he infiltrates a C-rank guild  pretending to be F-rank to conduct research.
Though he joined the guild just to get ideas for his novel, surprisingly, he thinks “This guild… I kind of like it?” As he directly observes the desperate survival stories of low-rank hunters, he gradually grows both as a human and as a writer.
Can this boy who was once a ‘god’ successfully debut as an ordinary human and writer?
associated_names: Sorry, I'd Like to Save the World, But I Have a Deadline to Meet (webtoon)
今日から英雄やめて作家になります

107760.synopsis:
My best friend and I hit the jackpot and got sent to a world that’s both familiar and strange.
Familiar because it’s a parallel world from ten years ago, mostly the same as my memories.
Strange because… Why am I a girl?! And you turned back into a handsome guy!
Brother, you’re not a simp, right? That woman is going to cheat on you in the future!
Brother, you’re a time traveler! How can you just live off a rich woman?!
Brother… the way you’re looking at me is getting weirder and weirder!
associated_names: After Becoming A Girl, My Best Friend Kept Hitting On Me
重生后挚友总想攻略我

108016.synopsis:
A man who was once the strongest in the world…
Betrayed and killed unjustly—only to wake up in a pink female body?!
“Even in this kind of body… I will never give up!!”

109296.synopsis:
Villain… eliminated… off work… happiness ?
Just remember one thing.
The only good villain is a dead one.

109552.synopsis:
At 26 years old, Jiang Liuyi impulsively went along with the trend and married someone on a whim. Her spouse, a woman the same age as her, was gentle and good-tempered. What made all her friends envious was her wife’s absolute devotion and willingness to indulge her in everything—even knowing Jiang Liuyi only married her as a stand-in for her ex-girlfriend. Yet, her wife stayed by her side without complaint, sweetly accepting it all.
Jiang Liuyi thoroughly enjoyed this arrangement.
Later, her ex-girlfriend returned to the country, and they had to meet for work-related reasons. Friends teased Jiang Liuyi, asking if she’d have to kneel on a washboard at home. It was then she realized… her wife had never asked her a single question about her ex.
Tagline: You have your white moonlight; I have my cinnabar mole.

110064.synopsis:
65 years ago, the Gate Era began.
With the emergence of Espers and Guides, individuals with extraordinary abilities, society rapidly transformed.
Amidst this chaotic shift, Siho, who lost his family and developed a severe hatred towards Espers, lives a difficult and broken life, both physically and mentally.
Then, one fateful day, Siho finds himself trapped inside a Gate at the crossroads of a choice.
His destiny takes an inevitable turn when he encounters Kang Jae-yoon, who entered the Gate seeking death.
“The true precursor to rampage is when the eyes turn red.”
“Like your eyes right now?”
At the moment of death, Siho, who awakens as a Guide, is violently assaulted by Jae-yoon, who has gone rampage.
In exchange for enduring this merciless beating, he is granted a new life.
Due to the law, Siho is forcibly bound as Jae-yoon’s Pair Guide, and soon, three of this other Espers approach him.
In a tangled web of relationships formed by choice or fate, the emotions of these five individuals become increasingly intertwined.
And as their fragile everyday lives begin to unravel, a new threat to humanity emerges– the Black Gate.
———————————
※This work contains intense violence, profanity, and non-consensual relations. Please take this into consideration when reading this work.

110576.synopsis:
A young rebel with aspirations to overthrow the dynasty one day experiences a stirring of romantic feelings. During these turbulent times, Princess Yongying suffers a head injury during a bandit attack and ends up with a scrambled memory, mistakenly believing herself to be the heroine of a certain novel. This wouldn’t be an issue, except she also mistakes her arch-nemesis for her secret lover. Watching her lover return from battle but not come to see her, seemingly forgetting all about her, the once haughty princess angrily lowers herself, grabs a ladder, and sets it against the wall of the general’s residence.
The twin brother dies unjustly at the frontier, and Yuan Ce conceals his brother’s death, impersonating the “miraculously surviving” sibling to return to court and begin settling scores. Unexpectedly, despite gaining the emperor’s trust and evading suspicion from political rivals, he can’t escape the night when a girl climbs over his wall, knocks on his window with a look of grievance—“Brother Ce, you haven’t come to see me in so long, do you no longer like me…?” “… ” No one informed him that they were this kind of mortal enemies.

113648.synopsis:
“Miss Witch, I hate you.”
“Why?”
“When I was a child, you killed all of my family. I remembered your horns, and I remembered your eyes. I hate you. I hate all witches like you—you’re all lunatics.”
“But now you’re a witch too. You’re one of us.”
“I hate myself too. But you won’t let me die.”
“You’re very obedient.”
Funis…

115440.synopsis:
Transmigrated to Neon, becoming a boy named Jaden Yuki. He thought he had merely transmigrated to a parallel world, coincidentally sharing a name with a certain protagonist.
Until that day, Yubel appeared in Jaden Yuki’s life.
“Jaden, my beloved, I will forever protect you…”
…
Awakening the Supreme King, fusing with Yubel, and assembling an entirely new Dark Hero deck.
When a brand-new Jaden Yuki appeared in the dueling world, everything changed.
Jaden Yuki: In this life, I will no longer be a lonely hero, but a—
Ultimate ‘Dark Hero’ who will make the entire world tremble!
associated_names: 游戏王：十代，你管这叫英雄？

117488.synopsis:
You chose to be a Druid and reincarnated into a xianxia world, only to be born into the belly of a refugee woman, wailing into a world of disaster. Starting off in hardship, you quietly tilled the land and grew in strength, keeping a low profile. From the ancient peach tree that had stood in the village for a thousand years, you comprehended Breath of the Tree, which extended your life. From birds and beasts, you gained insight into Beast Form Intent, bringing prosperity to your martial path.
You used Nature’s Gift to bless your descendants, used Plant Growth to speed up the cultivation of spiritual herbs, used Animal Companion to form bloodline contracts with spirit beasts, and used Emerald Dream to build a sacred sanctuary.
As time passed, your clan flourished and thrived. Generation after generation, your descendants were born with exceptional talent. Not only were they naturally in tune with spirit beasts and immortal plants, making it easier to comprehend the Dao through nature, even the Heavenly Dao itself began to show favor toward your clan.

121840.synopsis:
I had loved Zhou Jingnan through countless springs and summers.
Loved him so much that everyone thought I couldn’t live without him.
Later, we broke up.
On the first day after the breakup, everyone was waiting to see me make a fool of myself.
By the seventh day after the breakup, they started guessing when I would beg Zhou Jingnan to take me back.
By the second month after the breakup, Zhou Jingnan stood beneath the girls’ dormitory building, knees slightly bent, eyes bloodshot.
What he didn’t know was that this breakup had been my carefully planned choice all along.
In this world, no one is born to love waiting.
associated_names: 分手是我蓄谋已久的选择

123632.synopsis:
When Xue Yu was young, she held a noble status — the cherished little princess of Ye City. In her youth, she stood at the Six Realms’ Judgment Platform, where countless condemned prisoners awaited their fate. Among them, her gaze fell upon Song Heng, a near-lifeless youth whose immortal bones had been extracted, leaving him broken and barely breathing.
No one could have predicted that this young man, pointed out on a whim by the princess, with his tendons severed, unable even to stand—would later clench his teeth, swallow his blood, and climb his way up step by step with nothing but his sword in hand. From noble title to Daoist lord, from sect master to the very throne of the Immortal Realm’s sovereign, he rose against all odds.
Xue Yu always believed that even a stone could be warmed by devotion. For thousands of years, she poured her heart into melting Song Heng’s icy resolve. Yet, instead of tenderness, she was met with his army crushing Ye Du beneath their boots as he triumphantly brought back his long-lost white moonlight—the woman he had yearned for all along.
On the day of his victorious return, the Heavenly Palace was ablaze with lanterns and celebration. In the grand hall, Song Heng removed his armor, gripping a bloodstained sword, and said to Xue Yu, “This was never my wish, but a necessity I could not avoid.”
That night, Xue Yu burned herself into raging flames, annihilating her own soul in a final act of vengeance—taking Song Heng with her into oblivion.
Yet by fate’s twist, both awoke a thousand years in the past.
This time, the young Song Heng lay on the Judgment Platform once more—a dying creature, his body lashed with whip marks, barely clinging to life.
But now, Xue Yu sat high upon the throne, her gaze sweeping past him without pause.
After a long silence, she extended a delicate finger, pointing not at Song Heng, but at the fierce, wolf-like boy beside him—another punished soul, his eyes blazing with untamed fury.
Her lips parted, the words soft but decisive:
“I choose him.”

124400.synopsis:
Story Summary:
【Scheming Yet Gentle Designer × Tsundere Temptress Heiress】
The day Yan Yiyun was parachuted into the Business Department, half the company came out to gawk at the tall, beautiful woman. Gossip ran wild in private chats—she was rumored to be the legitimate heiress of the corporation, a real-deal rich and beautiful socialite. Countless people tried to cozy up to her.
Only Qi Zhen remained indifferent, focused solely on rushing her design deadlines.
People scoffed at her: What’s the use of working so hard? She’s just a low-level designer anyway.
Until they saw Yan Yiyun trailing behind Qi Zhen every day, circling around her trying to get her attention. She even pulled pranks—like swapping the cream filling of her Oreo with mint toothpaste—until Qi Zhen finally lost her patience and snapped:
“What exactly do you want from me?!”
Yan Yiyun pulled out a tattered slip of paper from her designer LV bag, eyes brimming with tears, and said:
“Didn’t you promise to marry me?”
The company gossip group… exploded.

134640.synopsis:
When Qiu Xinran was young and living in the capital, a war broke out in the northwest, and General Xia mysteriously disappeared.
She risked everything, using a divination to send the long-ailing young master of the Xia family to the war-torn frontier.
For seven years, Xia Xiuyan was stationed at the border, marching day and night, fighting in bloody battles.
For seven years, Qiu Xinran hid in the mountains, living a life of morning bells and evening drums, detached from worldly affairs.
In the eyes of the world, he was a loyal and protective general, while she was a treacherous and deceitful villain, as rumors claimed.
But what she didn’t know was that on that day by the willow-lined riverbank, the young man had already developed a deep admiration for her.
“Years ago, with that one divination in the imperial court, the Daoist master understood my aspirations, and I understood the Daoist master’s earnest efforts.”
After seven years of spring and autumn, they meet again in the imperial hall. Is my old friend here in Chang’an now?
associated_names: Where Nothing Is Forbidden and Everything Aligns
Zhu Shi Jie Yi Bai Wu Jin Ji

135664.synopsis:
“I’m a succubus, Sun Jinyan. I’m born rebellious and I hate getting married and having kids!”
I never expected that those old-fashioned people in the clan would…
He actually kicked me, a succubus who didn’t want to have children, out of the tribe.
A bolt of thunder struck a melodramatic period novel!
I found out that I had already traveled through the book and had just awakened!
Two months later I will graduate from high school and go to the countryside.
It is about to be revealed that she is a cannon fodder female supporting role who is a fake daughter!
How can I live like this?!
If the identity is revealed, it will be a double blow and death!
At the critical moment, the childbearing system descended from the sky and forcibly bound!
“To live or to die? How can this succubus endure such an injustice!”
But in order to survive… she endured!
System guidance, target locked.
Li Chengyun, a divorced high-ranking official with great power and great luck!
To avoid going to the countryside! To avoid starving to death!
For the sake of two cheap brothers!
Sun Jinyan gritted his teeth and said, “Done!”
So what about the aloof and divorced factory manager Li Chengyun? Get him!
After a night of passion, I got the system reward and gave the job to my brother. I’m so happy!
With her baby in her arms, she approached Li Chengyun with her belly bulging: “I want an abortion, please sign!”
Li Chengyun looked at the four clear gestational sacs on the B-ultrasound report and his pupils trembled.
“…Quadruplets?! If you dare, try aborting them! Come with me to register immediately!”
Ding! Successfully bound your long-term meal ticket and start your life of marrying high!
System prompts: The more offspring the host has, the richer the rewards will be, and there are also mysterious rewards waiting for you!
Sun Jinyan: “…”
To survive, live! You must live!
No one can stop me from completing the system KPI!
associated_names: 拒下乡，魅魔靠孕肚拿捏大佬！

136432.synopsis:
I became a cultist who worships an evil god—
…in a world where the authority of that very god has fallen to the lowest depths, crushed beneath the light of the good gods.
Now is the age of balance, where even cultists are no longer objects of persecution.
In Plethica, the city of harmony where countless labyrinths lurk beneath its shining streets, one must offer human sacrifices just to make a living as an explorer.
“Why didn’t you take off the head before presenting it?”
“That one’s too ugly. Bring me someone prettier next time.”
“U-um… this one feels a little undercooked….”
…Aren’t you all being just a bit too picky with your offerings?

144112.synopsis: The gay bar owner, Tomoharu, may look manly on the outside, but he speaks in a flamboyantly effeminate tone. One day, he happens to help an otaku named Matsuo, who was mistakenly accused of shoplifting, and proves his innocence. Deeply moved by Tomoharu’s bold and manly way of standing up for him, Matsuo begs Tomoharu to teach him how to be more manly too. Overwhelmed by Matsuo’s enthusiasm, Tomoharu hides his effeminate speech and decides to go along with him.

149744.synopsis:
[You are a failed canary, lowly, foolish, and jealous. In your last life, you lived in destitution, possessing nothing. Despite all your schemes, you failed to win your sponsor’s favor. Their love was always for someone else.] 
“…And then?”
[I will give you a chance at rebirth.] 
[Get close to him] 
[Make him fall in love with you] 
“And then?”
[Kick him to the curb.] 
[I am not a god, I am a demon. I enjoy devouring the pain and despair they feel after being abandoned by the one they love. It brings me pleasure.] 
[Whatever your wish, I can grant it. Everything you couldn’t obtain in your last life, you can have in this one—money, fame, status…] 
“But I want his love.”
This is a story about a wicked little System and countless Hosts battling their wits.
————————
I want to play a love game with you, to see who falls first in this life.
I am the one covered in filth, and I am also the one untouched by dust.
I will wear a gorgeous mask, concealing my intentions,
Carefully help you up when you fall, and gently embrace you when you’re in a mess,
I want you to be my captive, a moth drawn to a flame.
I want you to fall in love with me, with no way out.
I’m not a rose, I’m a mad dog, rotten to the core, yet I insist on a true heart.
In this game against a true heart, one must give their all.
Last life, it was me,
This life,
You.

195824.synopsis:
I was a predator and beastman known as a black-footed cat, but with my nothing-but-cute looks, I was forever getting rehomed as some family’s house cat, or — on the grounds that I was a rare beast — put up as collateral for my father’s debts. Even now, grown up, holding my own, and cut off from my father, nothing had changed. My father fooled me with one of his fake little performances and then sold me off as debt collateral all over again. Except this time the loan sharks were no ordinary lot. They were tiger beastmen. The native predator said to be the most dangerous in all of Korea. And the man at their head was rude past all belief. He’d take one look at me and call me bean-sized, call me a runt — and then he’d swat me and call me “baby,” brushing me off completely.
“There you go. Good boy. I’ll open the can for you.”
“I’ll be home late tonight. Be good and play nice.”
“That’s because our baby’s so clever.”
And yet the man’s manner was stranger than that of any human, any beastman, I’d ever met. Rough but tender, dangerous but warm. Bit by bit I grew guilty, and scared. Because I was the one deceiving him.
“Mrrrow….”
Master…. The truth is…. I’m a beastman. Not an ordinary cat. Even so — am I still your baby? Do you… like me? Will you keep on liking me?
